@graph.headline: Muhurat Trading 2026: Date, Timings, and How the Session Works (Official NSE/BSE Schedule)
@graph.description: Muhurat Trading 2026 is on Sunday, 8 November 2026, 2:20–3:30 PM IST. Full official NSE/BSE schedule, CAS explained, segments open, and settlement basics.

acceptedAnswer.text: Muhurat trading is a special 70-minute trading session held on Diwali's Laxmi Pujan day — in 2026, Sunday 8 November — so investors can mark the start of the new Samvat year (Vikram Samvat 2083) with an auspicious first trade on NSE and BSE. Every trade placed is a real trade with real settlement.

mainEntity.name: When is Muhurat trading 2026, and what are the timings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Muhurat Trading 2026 is on Sunday, 8 November 2026. Official schedule (IST) per NSE circular NSE/CMTR/76941 and BSE notice 20261019-9 (both 19-Oct-2026): block deals 1:50–2:05 PM; pre-open 2:05–2:20 PM; main session 2:20–3:30 PM (CAS securities close 3:15 PM); closing auction 3:15–3:35 PM; post-close 3:50–4:00 PM; trade modification cut-off 4:15 PM.
No. Participation is entirely optional — if you don't log in, nothing happens to your account or holdings.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a separate demat or trading account for Muhurat trading?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your existing active demat and trading account works; you only need funds in the account and to place orders within the session timings.

mainEntity.name: Can I trade futures and options during Muhurat trading?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Equity futures & options are open during the Muhurat session, along with equity, currency derivatives, commodity derivatives, and SLB, with normal margins and rules applying.

mainEntity.name: Does the settlement process differ from a regular trading day?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Standard T+1 settlement applies: shares bought are credited by T+1 evening, sellers receive funds on T+1. Around the 2026 session: Sun 8 Nov (Muhurat), Mon 9 Nov (normal trading), Tue 10 Nov (closed, Diwali-Balipratipada), trading resumes Wed 11 Nov.

mainEntity.name: How much money do I need to participate?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no regulatory minimum investment; investors commonly place small token trades. Practical limits are the share price and normal brokerage charges, and normal circuit filters apply.

mainEntity.name: Are brokerage charges the same during Muhurat trading?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Charges are the same as a regular trading day under your normal brokerage plan. Reference figures: STT 0.15% sell-side on equity delivery, NSE equity-options transaction charges 0.03553% per side all-in.

mainEntity.name: Is Muhurat trading guaranteed to be profitable?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The session's significance is traditional and symbolic; press coverage has not framed it as being about immediate profitability, and the short window can heighten volatility.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I miss the Muhurat session?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nothing bad — you only miss the symbolic window. The next regular trading day is Monday, 9 November 2026.
